description: Script system full refactor — consolidation, naming convention enforcement, and duplicate elimination

format.reason: Format layer unification — 'format' renamed to 'format:write' for clarity

format:biome.reason: Format layer unification — merged into format:write (biome + prettier in one pass)

format:prettier.reason: Format layer unification — merged into format:write (biome + prettier in one pass)

format:check:biome.reason: Format layer unification — merged into format:check

format:check:prettier.reason: Format layer unification — merged into format:check

arch:refresh.reason: Architecture layer simplification — governance is the canonical audit + refresh entrypoint

arch:audit:check.reason: Architecture layer simplification — check-only mode merged into arch:governance

arch:fix.reason: Architecture layer simplification — fix mode under governance namespace

validate:scripts:runtime.reason: Validation layer consolidation — runtime check merged into validate:scripts:all

validate:scripts:broken.reason: Validation layer consolidation — broken detection merged into validate:scripts:all

validate:scripts:registry.reason: Validation layer consolidation — registry diff merged into validate:scripts:all

validate:runtime:scripts.reason: Duplicate of validate:scripts:runtime — consolidated into validate:scripts:all

test:unit:debug.reason: Redundant — use 'bun run test:unit -- --reporter verbose' instead

format:write.reason: Unified format write — replaces format, format:biome, format:prettier

format:check.reason: Unified format check — replaces format:check, format:check:biome, format:check:prettier

arch:governance.command: bun run arch:audit && bun run arch:gitnexus:context
arch:governance.reason: Unified architecture governance — replaces arch:refresh, arch:audit:check

arch:governance:fix.reason: Architecture governance fix mode — replaces arch:fix

validate:scripts:all.command: bun scripts/validate/runtime-scripts.ts && bun scripts/validate/detect-broken-scripts.ts && bun scripts/validate/diff-script-registry.ts
validate:scripts:all.reason: Unified script validation — replaces validate:scripts:runtime + broken + registry

validate:scripts:fast.reason: Fast script validation for pre-commit paths — quick runtime check only
